title: Register a trade mark
summary: This page explains what a trade mark is and how registering one gives you exclusive legal rights to use it throughout Australia.
intro:
A trade mark (sometimes called a brand) is the way you show your customers and the public who you are. Your trade mark might be:

When you register a trade mark, you get exclusive use of the trade mark throughout Australia. This means you get a legal right to take action against any other business that tries to use the trade mark to provide goods or services similar to the goods or services your business provides.

Note: You can check the availability of your trademark with IP Australia’s trade mark checker tool before you apply.
